name: Bisq
description: Bisq's retrieved desktop updater downloads a platform installer plus detached OpenPGP signatures and signer material from bisq.network and bundled resources. It matches the signing-key identifier to candidate keys and verifies the installer bytes with Bouncy Castle; the documented flow then leaves installation for the user.
limitations: This is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study release; the evidence does not independently establish release-server behavior or full-key fingerprint policy beyond the checked-in identifiers.
